channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Russia may seek prisoner swap after detaining Japanese journalist
item.description: Some say the detention of the reporter is linked to the handover to Germany this month of a Russian hacker detained in Japan in May.

item.title: All Toyota models to be software-based by 2030
item.description: The move will help Toyota generate revenue through software update fees after delivery.

item.title: Takaichi makes ritual offering to Yasukuni Shrine
item.description: The prime minister is expected to skip a visit to the Shinto shrine during the three-day festival, which runs through Monday.

item.title: Now is the time for Japan’s most flavorful shiitake
item.description: The most popular mushroom in the country reaches peak flavor in two periods — one of which is happening right now.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
